directionProbe.threshold: angle over 60° between dictionary and candidate start-to-end vectors
directionProbe.note: 嗔 4-5 and 朕 3-4 are the form differences themselves (眞 匕 against 真 十, and the 月 interior dots against bars), so those glyphs are held rather than corrected.

subThresholdSlants.method: direction-probe.mjs rows with an angle of 45° to 60°: 13 rows, none corrected
subThresholdSlants.note: All thirteen are short dots the dictionary draws vertically while the licensed corpora slant them (猝 4, 廚 1, 註 8, 竣 1, 疹 1, 膣 5, 嫉 4, 搾 4, 窄 1) or the short 火·糸 strokes of 踪 8, 紂 5, 紬 5 and 櫛 13. Kept as licensed geometry, as in the earlier batches.

sourceTransform.note: No dictionary SVG in this batch uses a translate(x, -y) horizontal offset.
